pitch.heading: Down the delta road to Ombra
pitch.text: Ombra is a city of masks. Between the Third Bell and the Ninth nobody in it is anybody: bakers are Cockles, ferrywomen Gulls, and to say aloud who is under a mask is the one crime the city will not forgive. The Registrar, who kept the Book of Faces, lies dead in her chapel in her white mask, and the Book is gone, and in nine days, if the Drawing is not held, every Office in Ombra dissolves at midnight. The law has one lawful move left: to hire a Bare, a stranger who is no one, to look at what no one may. You have fourteen coin, and the delta road under your feet.
